text: Small businesses are the life-blood of communities. The current COVID-19 virus has in many cases irrecoverably harmed the post-pandemic recovery, with beloved local restaurants, bars, speciality shops and more closing for good. Even prior to the pandemic, many main street retail buildings have seen long standing challenges with high property taxes due to above average property assessment increases. One of the key measures the City can take to assist the long-term health of these small businesses is to implement property tax relief both during and post-pandemic to ensure the rebuilding of main streets post-COVID.
